units.source_text: 我劝他不要打那些零工了，还忠告他暂且放松一下身心，休养身体，方为长远之策。

en.t: I urged him to stop taking those odd jobs, and advised him to relax his mind and body for a while and recover his health, since that would be wiser in the long run.

units.source_text: 我早就料到倔强的K是不会轻易听从我的劝告的，

en.t: I had long expected that stubborn K would not easily listen to my advice,

units.source_text: 可没想到比预想的还要费力，真是无计可施。

en.t: but I had not imagined it would take even more effort than I expected, and I was truly at a loss.

units.source_text: K一向主张，做学问不是自己的目的，而是为了培养自己的意志，成为坚强的人。

en.t: K always maintained that scholarship was not his goal in itself, but a way to train his will and become a strong person.

units.source_text: 他由此得出的结论是：为此必须尽量使自己处于困苦之境。

en.t: From this he concluded that, for that purpose, he had to place himself in hardship as much as possible.

units.source_text: 在一般人看来，这简直是异想天开。

en.t: To ordinary people, this seemed utterly fanciful.

units.source_text: 而且，在困境中，他的意志丝毫没有得到增强，

en.t: Moreover, while he was in hardship, his will had not grown stronger in the least,

units.source_text: 反而整个人像是得了神经衰弱症。

en.t: and instead he seemed as if he had become neurasthenic.

units.source_text: 我没有办法，只好装出极其同情他的样子，

en.t: Having no other choice, I pretended to feel the deepest sympathy for him,

units.source_text: 甚至告诉他，我也准备同他一起朝着那个目标奋斗下去。

en.t: and even told him that I too was prepared to keep striving with him toward that goal.

units.source_text: （其实，我这么说也不完全是随口胡编。

en.t: In fact, what I said was not entirely made up on the spur of the moment.

units.source_text: 耳濡目染之下，我也渐渐被K的主张吸引了，

en.t: After hearing and seeing it so often, I too had gradually become drawn to K's ideas,

units.source_text: 他是有这样的吸引力的。）

en.t: for he did possess that kind of power to attract people.

units.source_text: 最后，我提出要跟他住在一起，一起去攀登通往山峰的崎岖之路。

en.t: In the end, I proposed that I live together with him and that we climb the rugged road toward the summit together.

units.source_text: 为了使倔强的K同意，我竟跪在他的面前恳求他，

en.t: To make stubborn K agree, I even knelt before him and pleaded with him,

units.source_text: 这才好歹把他拉到我的住处来了。

en.t: and only then did I somehow manage to bring him to my lodgings.
